Civil Engineering Draftsperson 
We are Mansys Pty Ltd, recruitment consultants. Our client, Empower Constructions, is actively looking for a Civil Engineering Draftsperson to join its team on a full-time basis to be placed at their office in Norwest, NSW 2153. The business specializes in external wall solutions, including Hebel installation, rendering, and painting services. They cater to commercial, industrial, and residential projects, offering high-quality cladding and facade installations. 
Position Overview
Assist in developing lightweight cladding designs and technical plans for residential and commercial structures, ensuring compliance with construction and engineering standards. The role requires skills in drafting, structural analysis, and liaising with stakeholders, fulfilling both project-specific and regulatory compliance needs. Having these technical and collaborative expertise is essential for Empower Construction’s niche offering in lightweight cladding solutions.
Main Responsibilities

•	Prepare detailed technical drawings and plans for construction projects, including Hebel installations and lightweight cladding in residential and commercial structures.
•	Collaborate with engineers and project managers to develop accurate designs and ensure compliance with Australian building codes and Empower Construction’s safety and quality standards.
•	Utilize computer-aided design (CAD) software to create precise 2D and 3D representations of project components.
•	Conducting accurate calculations for cladding material quantities, dimensions, and positioning.
•	Review and revise drawings based on feedback from stakeholders to ensure accuracy and adherence to project specifications.
•	Interpret architectural drawings, analyse potential technical challenges, and address them early in the design process.
•	Maintain organized records of all drawings, revisions, and related documentation for easy retrieval and reference. 
•	Assist in preparing cost estimates and project timelines by providing detailed drawings and material specifications. 
•	Conduct site visits to gather data, verify measurements, and ensure designs align with actual site conditions. 
•	Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, safety regulations, and Empower Construction's quality standards.
•	Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to incorporate specific requirements into the design plans.

Must Have

•	Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design from an Australian institution
•	Three Years of relevant Australian experience as a Civil Engineering Draftsperson

 Skills Required

•	Skilled in AutoCAD, Revit, and other drafting tools
•	Building trust and understanding client expectations
•	Excellent communication and presentation skills for conveying design concepts to stakeholders
•	Team Collaboration for working effectively with cross-functional teams
•	Effectively manage deadlines while maintaining high quality work


Successful candidate would be paid a base salary between A$110,000 to A$125,000 plus Superannuation.
 
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

About the business and the role  

You will be working for a national safety wholesaler with a Perth Head Office. You will be working from your own home office.
Ideally, you are located in Brisbane metro area.

Your role will be to 
1. Manage an existing wholesale client list;
2. Grow the client base with new clients; and
3. Cross selling products to the existing customers. 

The role is an autonomous role, reporting directly to the directors of the company based Perth. 

The business is a family owned company and has been in operation since 1980. The company imports and wholesales consumable safety products including hard hats, gloves, glasses, respirators, and much more. 

The fast changing pace of the industry ensures you are always challenged with different ideas and helping clients solve problems. 

The industry has many standards and we can help you improve your technical knowledge with our in-house training program. 

Job tasks and responsibilities  
The QLD/TAS Account Manager is responsible for servicing key regions including all of Queensland, NSW Northern Rivers. The area also includes all of Tasmania. Due to current structure, the role includes servicing a segment of Victoria.

The role provides great opportunity for travel throughout the key regions. 

You are responsible for planning your call cycles and regional travels to ensure clients are kept up to date with the latest developments. You will work closely with your interstate counterparts in NSW and WA.

In working with the customers, you may be required to undertake joint calls with your customer to visit the end users. 

You are required to report on sales actuals compared to budget on a monthly basis as well as prepare weekly call reports, and update Master Run Sheets.

The role requires you to participate in trade shows/events. 

Skills and experience  
An industrial and safety background is ideal but not mandatory. 

You must have a car to perform this role. 

Competent computer skills are important including being proficient at using Word, Excel, Outlook and Internet. 

A business to business sales call background is ideal. 

This role is open only to Australian Residents/Citizens. 

Successful candidates will be contacted for a phone interview and thereafter a video call and or a face to face interview.

Job benefits and perks  
A salary and motor vehicle allowance is provided. 
Mobile phone with calls and data is covered.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Cyber Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist to lead the implementation and continuous improvement of our organisation’s cybersecurity governance framework. This position is pivotal in ensuring that our systems, data, and infrastructure adhere to internal policies and external regulatory obligations, while proactively managing cyber risk and compliance across the enterprise.
You will work closely with executive leadership, IT teams, and external stakeholders to develop strategies, monitor controls, and report on risk posture, audit outcomes, and compliance metrics.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and management of cybersecurity governance frameworks, including policies, standards, and procedures aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, Essential Eight, and other relevant standards.
Perform risk assessments and control evaluations to identify cybersecurity risks across infrastructure, applications, and third-party vendors.
Develop and maintain the organisation’s information security risk register and assist in the treatment planning and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal and external audits related to cybersecurity and manage compliance reporting (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, CPS 234, GDPR).
Provide expert advice to business and IT leaders regarding security requirements, regulatory changes, and risk implications of new projects or technologies.
Monitor compliance with security policies, identify gaps, and drive remediation in collaboration with system and security teams.
Develop metrics and reporting dashboards for executive oversight of cyber risk, control effectiveness, and incident trends.
Lead training and awareness initiatives to embed a culture of security and compliance across all departments.
Liaise with external auditors, regulators, and compliance authorities where required.
Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a cybersecurity GRC or Information Security Compliance role.
Strong understanding of risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 27005, NIST RMF, FAIR), and regulatory standards (e.g., CPS 234, GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOX).
Demonstrated experience leading internal/external security audits and vendor risk assessments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including report writing and executive briefings.
Familiarity with GRC platforms and SIEM tools (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, Splunk, Microsoft Defender).
Relevant certifications preferred: CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent.
Why Join Us?
Work with a dedicated team driving cyber resilience across the organisation.
High-visibility role influencing security posture and risk culture at the executive level.
Career development and upskilling opportunities in a supportive environment.
Flexible working arrangements with a hybrid or remote-friendly structure.

On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.
